page.overview:
Who is Ice-Viper?

A group of Ice-Vipers piloting W.O.L.F.s were amongst the Cobras operating in the Arctic to maintain Cold War paranoia but they were defeated by the combined efforts of the G.I. Joe Arctic team and the Oktober Guard.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

The Ice Vipers were introduced in 1987, available exclusively with the W.O.L.F. vehicle. ---- Appearance: red face mask; white coat with grey collar; orange-brown pads on chest and shoulders; black gloves and belt; white pants with grey and black boots and orange-brown holsters

Accessories: dark grey goggled helmet with long, flared brim; two silver sais. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/87/iceviper.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/87/iceviper.shtml Filecard]
